before = [(n['color'],[p for p in n['boundary']][:2]) for n in previous_frame.segmentation['nodes']] if previous_frame else None
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':30}])

# diff summary
b = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation['nodes']
a = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
def sig(nodes):
    s=set()
    for n in nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']: s.add((p[0],p[1],n['color']))

sb, sa = sig(b), sig(a)

print("changed boundary pts:", len(diff))

def tiles(nodes):

    for n in nodes:
        if n['pixels']==36:
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d[(min(r),min(c))]=n['color']
    return d
tb, ta = tiles(b), tiles(a)
for k in sorted(set(tb)|set(ta)):
    if tb.get(k)!=ta.get(k): print("tile", k, tb.get(k), "->", ta.get(k))
